abort.already_configured: This Toshiba account is already configured

error.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. To protect your account from a lockout, try again later.

user.description: Enter the account you use in the Toshiba app.

reauth_confirm.description: The credentials for {username} are no longer valid. Enter the current password to reconnect.

blocked.message: Requests to Toshiba are paused to protect your account. Try again in about {minutes} min.

cannot_connect.message: Cannot reach the Toshiba cloud, or its answer cannot be used.

command_not_delivered.message: Toshiba did not deliver the command to the unit. It was not sent again.

entries_not_loaded.message: {failed} of {total} Toshiba entries did not load. The integration page shows what they need, and most retry by themselves.

token_rejected.message: Toshiba rejected the saved login. Enter the password when Home Assistant asks for it, under Settings → Devices & services.

reconnect.name: Reconnect
reconnect.description: Makes a new connection to the Toshiba cloud for all entries. A new unit appears by itself: use this to bring it sooner, if the last list of units is more than 15 minutes old.
